formulations.Polymer system Notes: PIGE is a statistical copolymer PEO323-stat-PIGE79 (Mn = 40 kDa, Đ < 1.2) with a constant mole fraction of imidazole moieties (xIGe = 0.17).
formulations.Transference notes: Li+ transference number in PIGE (0.19, at 80 °C) is slightly higher than that of the corresponding PEO-stat-PAGE system (0.15, at 75 °C).
formulations.Notes: Samples were dried in vacuo at 55 °C first for 8 h in a vacuum chamber in the glovebox (1 × 10−3 Torr) and then for 1 h in a high-vacuum oven (1 × 10−8 Torr).
